author: MinuteEarth
description:
Here's a simple recipe for animal conservation: find a species in trouble, identify the threats against it, problem-solve each one, and – voila! – the species will bounce back in no time. But it is a repeatable recipe for many species? 🦧🐧

Check out the WWF's Living Planet Report 2026: https://wwf.to/LPR2026
‪@WWF‬
title: Why Some Endangered Species are Easier to Help Than Others
